# Tapp Adjust Capacitor SDK

> Capacitor SDK for Tapp deep linking, attribution, device match and events with Adjust. A superset of tapp-capacitor-sdk: all core methods and events are unchanged, plus handleEvent, getAdjustAttribution and the adjust* family.

The package is tapp-adjust-capacitor-sdk version 0.1.0-alpha.2 (alpha).
Choose exactly one of tapp-capacitor-sdk or tapp-adjust-capacitor-sdk, never both; Android guards co-installation, iOS does not and co-installing is unsafe.
Use "device match" and "SHA-256 certificate hash". Never log tokens.
